title: About RNGdle - Daily Random Number Badge Game
description: Learn what RNGdle is, how the daily random number game works, and how badges, rarity, and EP are handled in this browser version.
meta: Reviewed and updated by the RNGdle Editorial Team.

sections.heading: About RNGdle
paragraphs: RNGdle is a compact browser game about making one random number feel meaningful. The game rolls a number, finds numerical patterns, assigns badges, and turns those discoveries into EP.
This project is a static remake of the core play experience. It focuses on account sign-in, local daily progress, badge scoring, and shareable roll summaries.

sections.heading: What this remake includes
paragraphs: The remake includes a daily roll, UTC reset countdown, local lifetime EP, rarity tiers, badge families, and a broad set of number-pattern checks.
It includes live account login and registration, but not server leaderboards, social hearts, claim tokens, or friend feeds.
